claim_verdicts.suggested_text: A provider that calls ref.watch on another is recomputed when that one changes. A FutureProvider that is not auto-dispose, like orderProvider, keeps its result until then or until invalidated. Riverpod keeps state across an app restart only with offline persistence, which orderProvider does not use; a browser page reload starts the app again.
